# Momentum Fitness | 30A CrossFit

> CrossFit gym in Santa Rosa Beach, Florida, on the 30A corridor. Coached group classes for beginners, locals, and vacationing drop-ins. Owned and coached by Jordan and John.

- Address: 170 Serenoa Rd, Bay 3, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459
- Phone and text: 850-502-3454
- Email: info@momentum.fit
- Hours (US Central): Mon to Thu 5:00a to 11:30a and 5:00p to 6:30p; Fri 5:00a to 11:30a; Sat 6:00a to 10:00a; Sun closed
- Google rating: 4.7 from 44 reviews

## Pricing
- Free trial class: fill out the interest form and a coach reaches out to schedule it
- Drop-in: $25 per class, $85 unlimited week (7 consecutive days), $189 one month unlimited (does not auto-renew)
- Unlimited membership: $189 per month
- Sessions pack: $530 for 30 sessions, use within 4 months
- Additional family member: $150 per month each
- Military and first responders unlimited: $160 per month

## Classes
- CrossFit: relatively high intensity, constantly varied, one coached hour
- Functional Bodybuilding: controlled intensity, tempo work, single-limb and core focus
- Open gym: self-directed time with a coach present
- Private coaching and 15 to 30 minute private consults for beginners
